 Memphis Grizzlies High School Sports Golf Grizzlies Podcast Tigers Basketball Tigers Football Player of the Week Add Daily Memphian to Home Screen Memphis Grizzlies Ja Morant says he holds no grudge as he prepares to play Grizzlies 
 By Drew Hill , Daily Memphian Updated: October 28, 2026 3:19 PM CT | Published: October 28, 2026 3:02 PM CT Portland Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant (1) during a preseason NBA basketball game against the Golden State Warriors, Friday, Oct. 16, 2026, in San Francisco. (Jeff Chiu/AP file)
 “Memphis is my home,” he said. “It’s still my home. It’s my last team. But I have other things to be focused on now.”  
 Topics
 Ja Morant Memphis Grizzlies Drew Hill
 Drew Hill covers the Memphis Grizzlies and is a top-10 APSE winner. He has worked throughout the South writing about college athletics before landing in Memphis.
